_meta.purpose: DICOM-like attribute mapping for classifier outputs on non-DICOM eye images (jpg/png/tif/bmp) and pass-through for real DICOM files. Values are 'as close to DICOM as possible'; a jpg is never a conformant DICOM instance, so every derived record must carry dicom_mapping_status = 'inferred_from_classifier' (non-DICOM) or 'read_from_header' (real DICOM).
_meta.standard_version_checked: DICOM PS3 current (2026d) on dicom.nema.org, fetched 2026-09-24

CFP.label: Color fundus photograph

IlluminationTypeCodeSequence_0022_0016.confidence: low, inferred default for flash fundus camera

CFP.notes: Handheld/smartphone fundus (Phelcom Eyer, Remidio) is still Fundus Camera. Red-free derived images would be ImageType Value 4 REDFREE, but the classifier does not separate them; leave COLOR only when SamplesPerPixel=3 and channels are not equal.

IR.label: Infrared reflectance (near-infrared SLO)
IR.notes: OP Image Type Value 4 has no defined term for IR; omit Value 4 rather than invent one. Spectralis IR 815/820 nm. A grayscale jpg saved as RGB (R==G==B) should be reported as MONOCHROME2-equivalent (flag rgb_is_gray=true).

PSC.label: Ultra-widefield pseudocolor (Optos-style)
PSC.SOPClassName_alternative_if_native_proje: Wide Field Ophthalmic Photography Stereographic Projection Image Storage
PSC.SOPClassName_alternative_3d: Wide Field Ophthalmic Photography 3D Coordinates Image Storage
PSC.notes: Optos pseudocolor = red (633 nm) + green (532 nm) laser channels, blue zeroed or synthetic; DICOM OP handles this with SamplesPerPixel=3, SamplesPerPixelUsed=2 and ChannelDescriptionCodeSequence. Only claim the Wide Field SOP classes for real DICOM files that already carry them; a jpg export has lost the projection geometry. Set SamplesPerPixelUsed=2 only when the blue channel is measured as all-zero, otherwise omit. Clarus (Zeiss) UWF is true color and will usually classify as CFP or PSC; record both via probabilities.

FAF.label: Fundus autofluorescence

alternative.when: manufacturer hint is Topcon, Canon, Zeiss Visucam, Kowa (flash FAF)

LightPathFilterTypeStackCodeSequence_002.confidence: low; Heidelberg BluePeak 488 nm excitation; Optos FAF uses green 532 nm (use 445465004 Green optical filter when hint is Optos)

FAF.notes: OP Image Type Value 4 defined terms are COLOR, REDFREE, RED, BLUE, FA, ICG only. There is no AUTOFLUORESCENCE term, so do not put one in ImageType; carry 'FAF' in a non-DICOM field (cmds_modality / envision_class) instead. Value 4 terms are 'defined' not 'enumerated', so a private extension is legal, but inventing one hurts interoperability.

OCT.label: OCT B-scan (cross-sectional)

alternatives: SCT 81016008 Optic nerve head (filename/description mentions ONH, disc, RNFL circle)
SCT 28726007 Cornea or 31636006 Anterior chamber of eye (anterior segment OCT)

OCT.multi_frame: A multi-page TIFF of B-scans maps to one OPT instance with NumberOfFrames = page count. A folder of per-slice PNGs is one volume only if filenames share a stem with an index; treat as one series, NumberOfFrames = count.
OCT.notes: OPT requires SamplesPerPixel=1 and MONOCHROME2 only, PresentationLUTShape IDENTITY, BurnedInAnnotation NO. Many Zenodo OCT jpgs are RGB screenshots with overlays: flag rgb_is_gray and burned_in_annotation_suspected.

OCTA.label: OCT angiography en face
OCTA.SOPClassName: Ophthalmic Optical Coherence Tomography En Face Image Storage

AcquisitionDeviceTypeCodeSequence_0022_0.note: En Face IOD carries device via source OPT/OPTBSV instances; recorded here as provenance hint

OCTA.notes: Modality OPTENF (not OPT) per C.8.17.17 Ophthalmic Tomography En Face Series Module (enumerated). Image Type Value 1 is always DERIVED. Color-coded depth maps (RGB jpg) do not conform (SamplesPerPixel must be 1); flag. Structural en face (non-flow) would be 128260 Retina structural reflectance map; the classifier cannot distinguish, so only OCTA flow is assumed. The flow source OCTA volume itself is OPTBSV (1.2.840.10008.5.1.4.1.1.77.1.5.8), not produced from 2D images.

NEG.label: Non-eye / non-ophthalmic image
NEG.notes: Plots, masks, histology, figures, external eye photos (external eye/face photos could be XC External-camera Photography, VL Photographic Image Storage 1.2.840.10008.5.1.4.1.1.77.1.4, but the classifier lumps them into NEG). Segmentation masks that accompany eye images should be flagged is_mask (binary or few unique values) rather than counted as NEG content; DICOM would use Segmentation Storage 1.2.840.10008.5.1.4.1.1.66.4, not modeled here.

common_attributes_all_eye_classes.BodyPartExamined_0018_0015: EYE (PS3.16 Annex L maps EYE to SCT 81745001 Eye; there is no RETINA Body Part Examined term)
common_attributes_all_eye_classes.ImageLaterality_0020_0062: R | L | B | U (from filename/path tokens; U if unknown). Type 1 in Ocular Region Imaged Module, so always emit a value.
common_attributes_all_eye_classes.LossyImageCompression_0028_2110: '01' for .jpg/.jpeg or TIFF compression 6/7 (JPEG); '00' for PNG, BMP, uncompressed/LZW/Deflate TIFF
common_attributes_all_eye_classes.LossyImageCompressionMethod_0028_2114: ISO_10918_1 for JPEG baseline; ISO_15444_1 for .jp2
common_attributes_all_eye_classes.BurnedInAnnotation_0028_0301: UNKNOWN (non-DICOM); set 'YES_SUSPECTED' in a side field if overlay text detected
common_attributes_all_eye_classes.PatientIdentityRemoved_0012_0062: YES (public Zenodo deposit; assumed de-identified, not verified)
common_attributes_all_eye_classes.RecognizableVisualFeatures_0028_0302: NO for retinal classes; unknown for NEG

PhotometricInterpretation_0028_0004.RGB: RGB (or MONOCHROME2 if R==G==B on a sample; flag rgb_is_gray)

pixel_header_derivations.PixelRepresentation_0028_0103: 0 (unsigned) unless PIL mode I or F with negatives
pixel_header_derivations.PixelSpacing_0028_0030: TIFF XResolution(282)/YResolution(283) + ResolutionUnit(296): unit 3 (cm) -> 10/res mm, unit 2 (inch) -> 25.4/res mm. IGNORE when res is 72 or 96 or 300 dpi (screen/print defaults, not physical), or unit 1 (none). Also accept ImageJ TIFF 'unit=micron' in ImageDescription(270) and OME-XML PhysicalSizeX. DICOM order is [row spacing (Y), column spacing (X)].
pixel_header_derivations.AcquisitionDateTime_0008_002A: EXIF DateTimeOriginal (36867) else DateTimeDigitized (36868) else DateTime (306); convert 'YYYY:MM:DD HH:MM:SS' -> 'YYYYMMDDHHMMSS'. Do not use filesystem mtime (zip extraction time).
pixel_header_derivations.ImageComments_0020_4000: TIFF ImageDescription (270) or PNG tEXt 'Description'/'Comment', truncated to 1024 chars
pixel_header_derivations.DeviceSerialNumber_0018_1000: EXIF BodySerialNumber (42033); drop it in the public repo outputs (quasi-identifier of a clinic device)

laterality.apply_to: the file path relative to the record root, split into components; test the basename first, then parent directories nearest-first; first hit wins
laterality.single_letter_guard: Accept bare r/l only when delimited by _ - . or space AND the basename has another delimited field (e.g. '12_L.png', 'pt3-R-faf.tif'); reject when the token sits next to a digit-unit pattern ('L1','R2' are OCT slab/lead names), and reject l/r/os/re when the path component is a known non-laterality word (e.g. a directory named 'os' next to 'bin', or 're' in 're-scan'). Record laterality_source = basename|dirname|none and laterality_token.
laterality.conflict_rule: If both R and L tokens are found in the same basename, set U and laterality_conflict=true.
laterality.record_level_rollup: Count R/L/B/U over images; emit ImageLaterality distribution in Excel (e.g. R:412 L:398 U:10).
laterality.scrape_observation: Top-level Zenodo file_names contain delimited l/r 49 times and os once; most eye files are inside zips so the rule must run on archive member paths.

manufacturer_hints_from_text.apply_to: record title + description (HTML stripped) + keywords + archive member paths + file extensions; case-insensitive; report all matches with the matched string

Optos.caution: 'ultra-widefield/UWF' implies wide field but not necessarily Optos (Zeiss Clarus also UWF); mark as weak

proprietary_extension_hints..img: ambiguous (Zeiss Cirrus raw or Analyze); only with cirrus context

manufacturer_hints_from_text.scrape_observation: Across all 515 unfiltered records text hits are rare (Canon 2, Zeiss 2, Heidelberg 1, Optos 1, Phelcom 1), so most rows will have Manufacturer empty or come from EXIF/DICOM headers.

real_dicom_passthrough.detect: extension .dcm/.dicom OR 128-byte preamble + 'DICM' at offset 128 (many ophthalmic exports have no extension)
real_dicom_passthrough.read_with: pydicom.dcmread(path, stop_before_pixels=True) for header; classify pixels only via pydicom + decoded frame when a handler is available
real_dicom_passthrough.compare: report header Modality/SOPClass vs classifier-predicted mapping; disagreement is a useful QC column (e.g. header OP but classifier says OCT)
